summary: Short kerb beside a junction on a through road with no parked cars.
reasons: No parked cars or parking lane

drivers.seclusion: Open grass and trees to the north; homes 52 m or more away, but the kerb sits in view of the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: The stretch is only 21 m long, next to a track mouth and junction; no pull-in or verge wide enough is visible, and the lane is narrow.
drivers.traffic: Through road with junction traffic and turning vehicles.
drivers.convention: No parked cars along this kerb; no signs.

flags: Low-lying: 2.2-2.4 m elevation, Toowong Creek 90 m away
sun_shade: Open to sun; trees shade the north-east side in the morning.
